name: box_delivery
title: Box delivery: realistic pick -> carry -> place -> real 90 deg corner -> walk away
summary: Realistic pick-and-place with a REAL corner: the G1 walks to cart A and stops with the box at its hands, takes it (two-phase proximity-gated lift -- no levitation), carries it down the south corridor to cart B, sets it down (two-phase place, real contact settle), walks on past the cart, takes a real ~90 deg footwork corner (TURN-LOOP, wtz=0) and walks away north, ending in a stand. THE HEADING BAND (measured, 10 runs): the turner's ghost spans exactly 0->90 deg absolute heading; every corner sweeping past ~95 deg fell/spun, so the there-and-back shuttle needs a heading-randomized turner retrain (named next step). Three deploy frame fixes are armed here: turn-frame FY brake, HARNESS_ATT_HEADING (body-frame attitude spring), TURN_OBS_RELATIVE (entry-relative rate obs).
_turn_note: seq.env overrides the turn_in_place defaults exactly as walk_turn_walk does: the 90-deg turner (wr_turn90 + ghost_turn_90) under TURN-LOOP with TURN_HOLD_LOCK=0; TURN_DECEL_DEG unset (loop mode plans passes, no decel). TURN_LOOP_MAX=6 is headroom only; every course turn targets the global TURN_TO_DEG=90.
props: harness_rig moves the box off BATON_MODE_FILE (side log _scratch/foot_redesign/boxrig.log)

verified.result: 3/3 headless (plus 2 environment FFI flakes excluded): box picked with a vertical two-phase lift from 0.35 m (hands at the box), carried 4.6 m south corridor, placed + settled at cart B's exact rest point (9.00, -1.40, 0.960) every run; corner 105-106 deg (TURN-LOOP pass 1); exit leg arrives (10.7, 1.9); ends standing; min z 0.659+, 0 falls
